newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq rallies to another higher close.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq rallies to another higher close.

text.p: Nasdaq stocks, powered yet again by the high technologies, closed higher on Thursday.
Not that the day didn't have its disappointments. TCSI Corp fell 4-1/2 to 11 after saying after Wednesday's close that it saw a loss in third quarter with revenues below second quarter levels.

But the mighty techs more than made up for the occasional blip, with U.S. Robotics up 7-1/8 at 73 as talk surfaced again that the company was preparing a faster speed modem and Cirrus Logic was up 2-1/2 at 21-7/8.
The Nasdaq Composite Index was up 3.37 points, or 0.28 percent, at 1228.03 at its unofficial close with advances leading declining issues by 2168 to 1890 on volume of about 726 million hares.
The most actively traded stocks was Iomega Corp which closed down 1-3/8 at 22-3/4 on very active volume of 27 million shares.
Shares of ValuJet Inc rallied 2-5/8 to 12-7/8 after the U.S. Department of Transportation said the company was "fit, willing and able" to resume its domestic flights.
